name: Benchmark v2

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: 'Task ID (e.g. 16912_4)'
        required: true
        type: string
      agent:
        description: 'Agent (e.g. x86)'
        required: false
        default: 'x86'
        type: string
      provider:
        description: 'Provider (e.g. AWS)'
        required: false
        default: 'AWS'
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model (e.g. gpt-3.5-turbo)'
        required: false
        default: 'gpt-3.5-turbo'
        type: string
      timeout_seconds:
        description: 'Timeout in seconds (default 3600)'
        required: false
        default: 3600
        type: number
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: 'V2 setup wait time in seconds (default 900)'
        required: false
        default: 900
        type: number

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 360
    concurrency:
      group: 'ts-bench-v2'
      cancel-in-progress: true

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository with LFS
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
      with:
        lfs: true

    - name: Create patches directory
      run: mkdir -p .patches

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bun install

    - name: Pull Docker image
      run: docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1

    - name: Disk cleanup
      run: sudo apt-get clean && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

    - name: Set environment variables
      run: |
        echo "TS_BENCH_EXERCISE=${{ github.event.inputs.exercise }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "TS_BENCH_AGENT=${{ github.event.inputs.agent }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "TS_BENCH_PROVIDER=${{ github.event.inputs.provider }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "TS_BENCH_MODEL=${{ github.event.inputs.model }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "TS_BENCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=${{ github.event.inputs.timeout_seconds }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
        echo "TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC=${{ github.event.inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

    - name: Run benchmark
      run: bun src/index.ts --dataset v2 --docker --exercise "${{ github.event.inputs.exercise }}"

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
      with:
        benchmark-results-dir: data/results/
        benchmark-name: ts-bench-v2
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        venv: ''
        if-no-files-found: warn

    - name: Upload logs
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: logs
        path: logs/

    - name: Upload benchmark summary
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: benchmark-summary
        path: benchmark-summary.txt

    - name: Upload patches
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: patches
        path: .patches/
